## 3. Reference fact kinds and schemas

- **authoritative_close_schema**:
  - **columns**:
    -
      - **name**: instrument_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: equals target entity.instrument_id
    -
      - **name**: session_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: equals target entity.session_id
    -
      - **name**: reference_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: k1:B(scope_id):B(source_close_id); B is unpadded base64url of UTF8; total <=128 codepoints and <=512 UTF8 bytes; decoded scope equals selection scope_id
    -
      - **name**: fact_kind
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: exactly ef1.close.authoritative
    -
      - **name**: effective_start_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **rule**: exactly ConfigSpec.session.close_ns
    -
      - **name**: effective_end_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: null or strictly greater than effective_start_ns
    -
      - **name**: text
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: exactly equals batch metadata source.snapshot_id (revision binding)
    -
      - **name**: price
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: supplied close coefficient at ConfigSpec.price_unit.scale; must be >0 to be admitted
    -
      - **name**: factor_num
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **rule**: absent or all null
    -
      - **name**: factor_den
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **rule**: absent or all null
    -
      - **name**: known_at_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: original publication knowledge; required causal in both availability modes
  - **metadata**:
    - **price_unit**: equals ConfigSpec.price_unit
    - **adjustment**: equals ConfigSpec.adjustment (also the bars adjustment)
    - **source.mapping_version**: ef1-reference-map1
    - **source.snapshot_id**: revision label
    - **coverage**: actual Coverage; admission requires complete expected=observed=row_count
    - **ordering**: declared
    - **duplicate_policy**: reject
    - **row_cardinality**: 0 or 1 rows admitted; >1 is DUPLICATE
